tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Reported by CNBC: OpenAI bugging suspect booked one-way ticket to Saudi Arabia with family before arrest.
Reported by The Verge: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn’t safe for kids.
Reported by Mashable: OpenAI lawsuit alleges company 'stole' children's data.
Reported by Central Nebraska Today: AG announces lawsuit against OpenAI for deceiving Nebraskans about the safety of ChatGPT.
Reported by The Guardian: OpenAI’s London staff receive average of £2.3m per person annually.
Free every hour.
